description: This file contains implementations of inverse hyperbolic functions (asinh, acosh, atanh) using rational number representations (PRAT). It includes mathematical computations such as logarithms, roots, and Taylor series expansions, and references external functions and data structures related to rational arithmetic.

methods.name: asinhrat
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic sine (asinh) of a rational number, using Taylor series for approximation when |x| >= 0.85, or logarithmic formula when |x| < 0.85.

methods.name: acoshrat
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic cosine (acosh) of a rational number, using the formula acosh(x) = ln(x + sqrt(x^2 - 1)), with domain check for x >= 1.

methods.name: atanhrat
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic tangent (atanh) of a rational number, using the formula atanh(x) = 0.5 * ln((1 + x) / (1 - x)).
